## Example 4.5 · A falling portfolio {#fm6-example-4-5-a .fm-slide }

A share portfolio, initially worth \$300 000 is reduced by 15% p.a. over a number of years.

a) Find the value of the investment after 7 years?

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 14 · Example 4.5 · Complete your working in the booklet.</p>

::: notes
Preserve source wording. $V=300000(0.85)^7=96173.126484375\approx\$96 173.13$. This is an assumed fixed-percentage model, not a forecast of actual investment returns.
:::
